response.sql: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id), average_total AS (SELECT AVG(total) as avg_total FROM player_totals) SELECT SUM(pt.total) as sum_of_totals, AVG(pt.total - ac.avg_total) as avg_excess FROM player_totals pt CROSS JOIN average_total ac WHERE pt.total > ac.avg_total
